title: magere-brug Recipe
description: Recipe schema for referencing source manifests and GOZ1 packs. goz1_pack/ternary_pack recipes carrying a `pack` block are executable by `magere pack-goz1`; the SAAQ runner lands in a later issue (#8).

type.description: Recipe kind. goz1_pack/ternary_pack drive packing; saaq runs SAAQ validation.

source_manifest.description: Path or registry id of the source model manifest

goz1_ref.description: Path or registry id of a registered GOZ1 pack (for post-pack steps such as SAAQ)

generated_format.description: Format of the primary generated artifact; prefer goz1

manifest_id.description: Manifest id to write or update after the recipe

output_dir.description: Directory for pack or SAAQ run outputs

pack.description: Pack runner configuration for goz1_pack/ternary_pack recipes, consumed by `magere pack-goz1` and mapped onto magere-grok-process QuantizeConfig. Omit for reference-only recipes that merely point at an existing pack.

dissect_manifest.description: Path to the xai-dissect DissectManifest JSON (schema_version 1, name_convention xai-dissect-v1) that lists preserve/fp16/ternary_candidates tiers

input_dir.description: Directory holding the packable source weights (safetensors shards or a directory of .npy files)

input_format.description: Weight container layout of input_dir; maps to magere-grok-process InputFormat

gif_threshold.description: GIF saliency threshold ratio used when ternarizing

use_embedded_baseline.description: Use the packer's embedded baseline statistics instead of deriving them from input_dir

allOf.$comment: A pack block only makes sense on packing recipes. It stays optional so reference-only goz1_pack/ternary_pack stubs remain valid; `magere pack-goz1` requires it at run time.
